moves.currentDescription: Ferrer proposes a nonreducible soul as leverage outside the material brain and therefore outside its alleged epistemic circularity.
moves.lockedProposition: A non-reducible soul supplies leverage outside the allegedly circular material brain and supports the existence of a supernatural mind.

moves.currentDescription: Dillahunty concedes brain fallibility but argues that investigation public evidence and independent confirmation can reveal and reduce cognitive error.
moves.lockedProposition: Brains are fallible but can discover and reduce error through investigation, public evidence, and independent confirmation.
